question: What decisive bodily event marks the moment of final release at death?
premises: The time of bodily fall arrives
The skull is split at that moment
This event is marked as decisive
inference: At the fall of the body, when the skull splits, that is the decisive moment.
uncertainties: kapālambhidyate is transmitted as a fused form
plain_english: O goddess, when at the fall of the body the skull is split, then that occurs.
